causalAutopsy.notes: The route POST /threadline/pairing/enable landed with #2248 (threadline enable without restart) carrying no write-domain declaration, so the §3.5 ratchet went red on main and on every branch containing that merge. The route region is byte-identical between this branch and origin/main, which is how it was attributed to main rather than to this branch. Caught by the ratchet exactly as designed; fixed here because it was blocking this PR and the Zero-Failure Standard owns it.
